final: WITH category_stats AS (SELECT category, AVG((NULLIF(spent, 0) - amount) * 1.0 / NULLIF(amount, 0)) AS ratio, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM budget GROUP BY category), overall AS (SELECT AVG(record_count) AS avg_count FROM category_stats) SELECT AVG(ratio), AVG(record_count), AVG(record_count - avg_count) FROM category_stats CROSS JOIN overall WHERE avg_count IS NOT NULL AND record_count > avg_count
